title: pilosella officinarum subsp. trichophora
intro: Pilosella officinarum subsp. trichophora, commonly known as Sheep's Sorrel, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the sunflower family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce symptoms of arthritis, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella officinarum subsp. trichophora include its ability to inhibit the activity of pro-inflammatory enzymes, and its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, have been reported to have antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
